I’ve lost count of how many games in a row I’ve been matched against players ranked way above me. Last match had two Divines on the enemy team, while I’m Legend 3. Final score 69–34 after 45 minutes, their safe lane went 22/5/13 and mid 23/3/25. We fought, but the rank gap showed in every fight and the game slowly slipped away.

The team average MMR might look similar, but that means nothing when your carry is Legend and the enemy carry is Divine 2. Dota is played in lanes and roles, not averages. One mismatched core decides the whole game, and the result is frustration, flaming and people who stop trying long before it ends.

Until Valve fixes this, don’t buy chests, Battle Passes or anything from the shop, and leave a negative review. Reviews and money are the only things they listen to.
